assessments.reasoning: LibVNC’s exact src/8to24.c pin contains both the versioned license notice and the exception before the closing comment delimiter. The three contiguous captures report the same expected digest.

The SPDX detail identifies the adjacent Runge grant and preserves the obligation to obey the GPL for code other than OpenSSL. Its contextual support extends to the exception’s identity and GPL reference only.

challenge.method: Tested GPL-2.0-only against the full preceding notice and checked whether the SPDX detail independently supplies a GPL version.
challenge.results: The express recipient option defeats a version-2-only reading. The SPDX text refers generically to the GPL. The edition and later-version option both come from the project header.

limitations: The file-level witness establishes the recorded base variant at its pin. It does not resolve other files, other releases, or which OpenSSL releases satisfy the same-license condition.
reasoning: The opening comment in src/8to24.c expressly offers “either version 2 of the License, or (at your option) any later version.” Runge’s OpenSSL permission follows within the same comment. This documents GPL-2.0-or-later for the named header.
